description: Read up to 10 published products from the public WooCommerce Store API and flag missing prices, missing images and out-of-stock items. Read-only: one run of GET requests only; never logs in, adds to cart or submits forms. Nothing is monitored or saved; ongoing checks are Store Canary Pro. A bare hostname is fine; URL paths are ignored and the host's homepage is checked.

url.description: The store's public address, for example https://example.com. A bare hostname (example.com) is fine. Any path, query or fragment is ignored: the homepage of the host is checked.

name: check_products

auditUrl.description: Full Store Canary audit (plain external link).

reportUrl.description: Shareable read-only report page. The result is encoded in the link; nothing is stored.

status.description: checked = findings below; otherwise no store request was made.

url.description: Normalized store origin that was checked.

title: Sample a store's products
